<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/api/posts/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The author can edit while still a member of the post's group; on a
cross-posted post the author's edit applies to every copy. An admin
can edit anyone's post (moderation) — only that one copy, never its
cross-posted siblings, and never a post in a circle the admin isn't
in (`404`, like reading it). Sets `editedAt`. Pass `null` for the
location fields to clear the location.
